candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: Given the five input dimensional quantities (rho, mu, D, U, epsilon), standard dimensional analysis (Buckingham Pi) yields two independent dimensionless groups governing the friction factor f_D: the Reynolds number Re = rho*U*D/mu and the relative roughness epsilon/D. Therefore f_D = F(Re, epsilon/D). All participating input quantities have well-known SI base exponents as below.
